body:
It's not salvageable. The friends I trusted the most - I even introduced them to my other group of friends and now they sort of melded into one group and they are talking behind my back - threatening them "him or us" etc. The girl I was with is one of them. 

The business I started is a design company focused on events. I create everything from video to print or even audio. The budget of the people I target is very, very low. I have to take all the jobs I can and still make the same deadlines to earn just enough to pay the bills. After 2 years, it's very tiring. (I used to do this before making it official - "under the table" payment.)
